_comment: This is an MMEngine/MMPose configuration file (declarative dicts only). No functions, classes, or callable APIs are defined. It configures a 2D human pose estimation training pipeline using RTMPose with a CSPNeXt-S backbone, SimCC codec, trained on AIC+COCO datasets for 420 epochs.
review_rtmpose_config: review the RTMPose-S config for 2D COCO keypoint estimation with CSPNeXt backbone and SimCC codec
summarize_rtmpose_config: summarize the RTMPose-S training config including optimizer, LR schedule, and data pipeline settings
review_train_pipeline: review the training data pipeline with RandomBBoxTransform, TopdownAffine, and Albumentation augmentations
review_model_architecture: review the TopdownPoseEstimator model with CSPNeXt-P5 backbone and RTMCCHead for 17 COCO keypoints
review_custom_hooks: review the EMAHook and PipelineSwitchHook custom hooks for staged training with reduced augmentation
